content.text: Exploratory Advising is the home for students who are exploring their interests and options before they declare a major.

Not sure what to major in? You’re not alone—and you’re in the right place. Exploratory Advising at Utah State University is here to support students who are still deciding on a major or considering a change. Whether you have a few thoughts or no clue where to start, we’re here to help you discover your strengths, explore your interests, and connect you to a meaningful academic path.

content.title: Canvas Exploration Station
content.text: The Exploration Station is your go-to Canvas resource for exploring academic programs, career paths, and course options that align with your interests and goals.

content.title: Academic Advisor
content.text: Advisors will align your strengths and interests with majors and courses. Schedule an appointment with an advisor at your location.

content.title: Peer Advisor
content.text: This is a no-pressure way to get help from someone who’s been in your shoes. They can help you plan your classes, understand Degree Works and Banner, and share real advice about professors, majors, and campus life.
Focus Areas are groups of majors that guide your major exploration. Explore pathways and courses aligned with your interests.
